facts.fact: The DGSN's end-of-2024 report says its Trusted Third-Party Identity Verification system, integrated with the Digital Identity Platform, lets citizens verify their identity in real time for administrative and financial transactions, and over 30 public and private institutions were approved in 2024 for direct use of it.

The DGSN reports that institutions approved for direct use of the Trusted Third-Party platform include the Ministry of Justice, the Directorate General of Taxes, Customs, national banks and financial institutions, and that its 17 framework agreements cover insurance, education, transportation safety, retirement funds and health.

The DGSN counts 17 framework agreements (including Bank Al-Maghrib, the Moroccan Banking Association and the Ministry of Health) and over 30 approved public and private institutions for direct use of the platform in 2024; no figure for verifications made is given.
